name: job-os
description: A local-first desktop workbench for managing job-search workflows, documents, and agent-assisted research.
author: Cobi

scripts.build: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @jobos/contracts build && pnpm --filter @jobos/desktop build && node scripts/verify-packaged-renderer.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm public:check && pnpm license:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.public:check: uv run python scripts/public-release/verify-public-tree.py && uv run python scripts/public-release/verify-fixture-manifest.py
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @jobos/contracts lint && pnpm --filter @jobos/desktop lint && uv run ruff check services scripts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @jobos/docx-engine test && pnpm --filter @jobos/docx-editor-core test && pnpm --filter @jobos/desktop test && uv run pytest
scripts.test:macos-native: pnpm --filter @jobos/desktop build:keychain-helper && pnpm --filter @jobos/desktop test:macbook-update && JOBOS_RUN_KEYCHAIN_INTEGRATION=1 uv run pytest -q services/api/tests/test_macos_keychain.py tests/connected_agents/test_phase0_harness.py
scripts.typecheck: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @jobos/contracts build && pnpm --filter @jobos/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @jobos/desktop typecheck
